en: Beware of sudden changes in weather in eastern and western Japan; rain clouds are moving to northern Japan; beware of landslides in areas where the earthquake was strong. The atmospheric conditions are extremely unstable this afternoon as well, so eastern and western Japan should be careful of sudden heavy rain and lightning strikes tonight. Rain clouds associated with the low pressure system and front will move into northern Japan, causing locally heavy rain. In areas where the shaking was strong due to the earthquake, you need to be careful about landslides. ``Extremely heavy rain'' observed in Ibaraki Prefecture Eastern and western Japan should be careful of sudden weather changes in the afternoon as well. en: [Weather for the day] May begins with May storm. Be careful of thunderstorms and gusts in northern Japan at night. The weather on Friday, May 1st was rainy across the country, with extremely heavy rain falling in the Kanto region. Let's look back at the weather for the day so far. ■What is Maystorm? On the 1st (Friday), a low pressure system accompanied by a front is developing and moving near Japan, and rain and winds are increasing over a wide area from western Japan to northern Japan. During this period, as on the 1st (Friday), low-pressure systems can rapidly develop near Japan, causing typhoon-like winds called the May Storm. The reason for such a severe phenomenon is the cold air left over from winter in the vicinity of Japan.

(Freitag) entwickelt sich ein von einer Front begleitetes Tiefdruckgebiet und bewegt sich in der Nähe von Japan, und Regen und Wind nehmen in einem weiten Gebiet von Westjapan bis Nordjapan zu. Während dieser Zeit, wie am 1. (Freitag), können sich in der Nähe von Japan schnell Tiefdruckgebiete entwickeln, die taifunartige Winde verursachen, die als Maisturm bezeichnet werden. Der Grund für ein so schwerwiegendes Phänomen ist die kalte Luft, die vom Winter in der Umgebung Japans übrig geblieben ist.

Die 1 (die Veneris), ratio pressionis humilis cum antrorsum crescit et movetur prope Iaponiam, et pluviae et venti in spatio late augentur ab occidentali Iaponia ad Iaponiam septentrionalem. en: The first strong wind in history in May in Sendai, which exceeded 30 meters, is on alert until the evening of the 2nd, with impacts on traffic. On the Pacific side of Tohoku, very strong winds will blow from the west into the evening. It is necessary to be on guard against damage to buildings and flying objects. Also, please be aware of the impact on transportation. description: Ο καιρός… «τρελάθηκε». Η ψυχρή εισβολή έφερε χιόνια στα ορεινά, βροχές σε πολλές περιοχές και θυελλώδεις ανέμους στο Αιγαίο. Θερμοκρασία ρεκόρ όλων των εποχών.
en: Weather: A very strong cold snap in May – Record low temperature recorded. The weather... "went crazy". The cold invasion brought snow in the mountains, rain in many areas and gale force winds in the Aegean. All time record temperature.
de: Wetter: Ein sehr starker Kälteeinbruch im Mai – Rekordtiefsttemperaturen verzeichnet. Das Wetter... „spielte verrückt“. Die Kälteinvasion brachte Schnee in den Bergen, Regen in vielen Gebieten und stürmische Winde in der Ägäis. Rekordtemperatur aller Zeiten.
la: Tempestas: franguntur frigora validissima in Maio – Record humilis temperatura notata. Tempestas... "insanus abiit". Frigore in montibus nix invasio intulit, pluvia in multis locis et ventorum vis ventorum in Aegaeo fuit. Omnia tempus tortor.

en: Crete: Hail and stormy winds in Heraklion - Ships were unable to dock at the port. Within five minutes the hail had whitewashed the yards in Heraklion – In port, gale force winds forced a cruise ship to return to Piraeus
